summary: GeoPark Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing interim condensed consolidated financial statements for Q1 2026. The filing reports revenue of $128.4M, operating profit of $58.0M, and net income of $20.2M. A $25M break-up fee from an unconsummated acquisition of Frontera Energy's assets is disclosed as other income. No new special-situation event is announced; it is a routine periodic financial report required of a foreign private issuer.
